_about: Character creation (systems PRD §5.1): eight occupations, each starting at proficiency 20 in one tree. Stories are placeholders in Durango's voice.

occupations.name: Soldier
occupations.story: Trained to fight; the jungle is just another posting.

occupations.name: Job Seeker
occupations.story: Took every hit life threw and kept walking.

occupations.name: Office Worker
occupations.story: Spreadsheets, deadlines, and a talent for putting things together.

occupations.name: Technician
occupations.story: If it has moving parts, you can fix it or sharpen it.

occupations.name: Flight Attendant
occupations.story: Neat stitches, calm hands, and a bag for everything.

occupations.name: Student
occupations.story: Curious about every leaf, berry and stone on the island.

occupations.name: Homemaker
occupations.story: Feeds anyone who sits down, even at the end of the world.

occupations.name: Farmer
occupations.story: Knows soil, seasons and how to wait for things to grow.
